currentProtocol.name: Lat Pulldown — Hotel Beginner
currentProtocol.instructions:
1. Set up for lat pulldown in a stable position with the listed equipment.
2. Use minimal-kit travel setup; keep the movement controlled rather than chasing speed.
3. Complete the prescribed repetitions while keeping technique consistent.
4. Stop the set if form deteriorates, then recover for the prescribed rest before repeating.

proposedProtocol.name: Wide-grip lat pulldown — Equipped setting (corrected draft)
proposedProtocol.label: Equipped setting — corrected draft
proposedProtocol.instructions:
Use the listed specialist equipment in a gym or properly equipped home gym. This is not a minimal-kit travel option. Follow the dose in reps_or_time and this base technique: Sit tall with thighs secured. Pull the bar towards the top of your chest by driving your elbows down, pause briefly, then let the arms straighten without shrugging. What it should feel like: the muscles down the sides of your back and around the shoulder blades
Keep it controlled enough that you could stop the rep cleanly at any point.
Move smoothly and stay in control.
Keep breathing normally; do not hold your breath.
Use only a comfortable range that you can control.

changes.after: 2 sets × 5 reps; 75s rest between sets. Use light resistance or an easy supported setup. Practise the same controlled path on every repetition.
